channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: The daily vulnerability report highlights a critical surge in remote code execution, memory corruption, and command injection flaws targeting enterprise desktops, cloud environments, and network infrastructure. High-impact issues affect major vendors including Microsoft, Cisco, SAP, and Adobe, with dangerous weaknesses found in Windows components, M365 Copilot, Cisco SD-WAN, and SAP BusinessObjects, while IoT ecosystems face widespread risks from ASUS routers and Ubiquiti devices. Emerging threats include AI pipeline compromises via model execution in NLP tools and prompt injection in Copilot, alongside supply chain dangers in Dependabot and active exploitation of the Google Brotli library. Industrial control systems and database middleware remain vulnerable to unauthenticated access and privilege escalation, underscoring the urgent need to patch critical infrastructure against these multifaceted attack vectors.
